history.period: 8th century CE (matha); present temple structures later
history.summary: One of the four cardinal peethams — the Dakshinamnaya (southern) seat — founded by Adi Shankaracharya in the 8th century CE, on the banks of the Tunga River at Sringeri (CSV town 'Sringeri' correct; district is Chikkamagaluru, not Shivamogga). Legend: Shankara saw a cobra sheltering a spawning frog from the heat here — a sign of the site's sanctity — and founded his first matha; Goddess Saraswati, who followed him as Bharathi, stayed as Sharada. The matha has an unbroken guru parampara; the 14th-century Vidyashankara Temple (built 1338 CE in the Vidyaranya era) is an architectural landmark with zodiac pillars. A major centre of Advaita Vedanta learning, Aksharabhyasa (Vidyarambha) ceremonies for young children, and free Nitya Annadana (thousands fed daily). Sources cited list Sri Sri Bharathi Tirtha Mahaswamiji as the presiding Jagadguru — verify the current pontiff as of visit date.

name: Sringeri Sharada Peetham (Sharadamba Temple)
town_description: Sringeri is a historic temple town in Chikkamagaluru district, Karnataka, on the banks of the sacred Tunga River at the foothills of the Western Ghats. It is best known as the seat of the first and foremost of Adi Shankaracharya's four cardinal mathas, making it one of Hinduism's holiest learning centres. The town is lush and serene, with the Sharadamba temple, the Vidyashankara temple, and the matha complex connected by a footbridge over the Tunga; it draws students, scholars, and pilgrims year-round, especially during Navaratri.

travel.road: Well connected by KSRTC/private buses from Shivamogga (~110 km), Chikkamagaluru (~90 km), Udupi (~100 km), Mangaluru

visitor_information.best_time: October to February; Navaratri (September-October) for the grand celebrations
visitor_information.opening_hours: Sharadamba Temple: 6:00 AM-2:00 PM, 4:00 PM-9:00 PM (multiple sources agree; verify on visit). Maha-Mangalarati timings vary by source: 10:00 AM, 11:30 AM or 12:00 PM, 7:30 PM (verify)
